articles.summary: HOUSTON, May 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Archrock, Inc. (NYSE: AROC) (“Archrock” or the “Company”) today reported results for the first quarter 2026. First Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenue for the first quarter of 2026 was $373.8 million compared to $347.2 million in the first quarter of 2025. articles.title: Archrock Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
